description: Free, no payment needed. Counts the alerts sec_market_alerts would return for the same `since`, `levels`, `types` and `tickers`, by level and type, with a new `cursor`. Counts only: the companies, filings and excerpts come with the paid sec_market_alerts, whose ready-to-send call is included when there is something new. Built for polling: peek for free every few minutes, pay only when new_alerts > 0. Rate-limited per client.

levels.description: Only these levels: red (restatement, delisting, bankruptcy, late 10-K), amber, green (insider buying), info (earnings, leadership changes, deals). Default: all.

since.description: Only alerts found after this time: pass the previous answer's `cursor` to get just what is new. Default: every alert in the store (about the last day).

tickers.description: A watchlist: only alerts for these tickers. Default: the whole market.

types.description: Only these alert types: bankruptcy, restatement, delisting_notice, late_annual_report, auditor_change, cybersecurity_incident, impairment, debt_acceleration, change_in_control, late_quarterly_report, insider_purchase, leadership_change, earnings, material_agreement, acquisition_or_disposal, restructuring, unregistered_share_sale. Default: all.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).

name: sec_alerts_peek
title: How many new SEC alerts (free)
